response.title: Grievance resolution within 7 working days
response.description: The system shall track every grievance against a resolution timeline of 7 working days from receipt, show the working days remaining to the District Social Welfare Officer, and escalate a grievance not resolved within 7 working days to the Joint Director, Social Welfare.
acceptanceCriteria: Given a grievance received on a Monday, when the DSWO opens the grievance list, then the grievance shows the working days remaining out of 7.

Given a grievance not resolved within 7 working days, when the daily job runs on the 8th working day, then it is escalated to the Joint Director, Social Welfare and both officers are notified by email.
response.rationale: GO para 7.3 sets a 7 working day resolution timeline that no requirement implemented.
